prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1305; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented with cervical and lumbar strain following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision. Symptoms reported included neck pain with restricted rotation, mid and low back pain with muscle guarding, and intermittent headaches originating from the cervical region. No focal neurological deficits were identified on examination. Imaging was not indicated at initial presentation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Conservative management was pursued over the course of 22 visits. Treatment included manual therapy, targeted soft tissue mobilization, progressive therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, and home exercise instruction. Modalities were used adjunctively for symptom control as needed.

Patient showed steady improvement in range of motion and pain scores across the treatment period. Residual stiffness with prolonged sitting and occasional neck discomfort persisted at the most recent evaluation, though functional tolerance for daily activities and work duties had substantially improved. Continued independent home exercise program and ergonomic modification were recommended. Follow-up on an as-needed basis is advised should symptoms recur.
